impact: If ZUG_DATA_DIR is set to a custom path, loadApiKey still reads ~/.zug/.env instead of $ZUG_DATA_DIR/.env, creating an inconsistency with storage.ts which fully respects ZUG_DATA_DIR.
resolution: loadApiKey now reads ZUG_DATA_DIR env var to locate .env file. synthesize-cli.ts fixed same way.
title: loadApiKey ignores ZUG_DATA_DIR for .env file lookup
